title: B1.11 sequential age-tracer compartment sweep for one explicit substep

baseline.source_equation: AgeTracer task-2 top-to-bottom compartment loop, internal Agefluxb recalculation, root/lateral uptake, AgeProd and concentration update

scope.substep: one explicit already-selected positive dtsolu value; daily stable-step selection and outer loop are excluded
scope.top_boundary: already derived top Agefluxt amount is an input
scope.internal_faces: recalculated in source order; an upper concentration updated earlier in this sweep feeds the next face interpolation
scope.bottom_boundary: B1.11 sign branch uses agedrain concentration for qbottom>0 and the final compartment concentration for qbottom<=0
scope.root_and_lateral: materialized water-rate inputs are converted to age sinks in source operation order; lateral drainage selects local age for qdra>0 and agedrain otherwise
scope.state_owner: None; returns only candidate concentration/storage arrays

qualification: 100000 deterministic multi-compartment sweeps bitwise-match direct B1.11 source order at O0 and O2
exercise bottom, internal-face, root and both lateral-drainage sign branches
invalid dimensions/nonfinite values/invalid geometry reject atomically
no multistep age transport, water-coupled state owner, accepted mass or production claim
decision_rule: Keep time-step selection, surface age pond boundary, output interval accumulators, trial ownership, restart and production migration separate; do not infer complete AgeTracer admission.
